releases.name: v1.3.0
releases.notes: Two versions of work are rolled up here (v1.2.0 and v1.3.0). ## Better agent discovery and chain safety - New `scripts/discover-agents.mjs`: a read-only, zero-dependency CLI that lists your custom agents (slim and native sources) and flags risky fallback chains — duplicate model ids, chains outside 2–4 entries, non-Go fallback ids not confirmed in the local registry, and vision lanes whose model is not marked vision-verified. It prints compact JSON instead of making you read config files by hand. - New `scripts/snapshot-summary.mjs`: a compact digest of the cached model snapshot (~97% shorter than the raw file), with `--ids`, `--trait`, and `--json`. ## Clearer recommendations - The recommendation table now includes a **role overview** column: a one-line, plain-language description of wha…

en.headline: 3 commits to sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu; opencode-go-model-picker v1.3.0 released
en.summary: On 2026-10-04, sogeisetsu made 3 commits to the sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu repository. The commits added entry status badges with UTC+8 time display and commit titles in summaries, fixed status change badges to preserve the actor's original case and introduced a --rerender flag, and added a GitHub homepage button, changed the 30-day card to update every 2 hours, and made AI failures retain the last narrative. A release was published for sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker at v1.3.0, rolling up v1.2.0 and v1.3.0 work. The release introduced scripts/discover-agents.mjs for read-only agent discovery and chain safety checks, scripts/snapshot-summary.mjs for compact model snapshot digests, and added a role overview column to the recommendation table.

releaseNotes.summary: Rolled up v1.2.0 and v1.3.0 work. Introduced scripts/discover-agents.mjs for read-only agent discovery and chain safety checks, and scripts/snapshot-summary.mjs for compact model snapshot digests. Added a role overview column to the recommendation table.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu 3 次提交；opencode-go-model-picker 发布 v1.3.0
zh.summary: 2026-10-04，sogeisetsu 在 sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu 仓库提交了 3 次代码。提交内容包括：新增条目状态徽章、UTC+8 时间显示及提交标题入摘要；修复状态变更徽章保留 actor 原始大小写并新增 --rerender 参数；添加 GitHub 主页按钮、30 天卡片改为每 2 小时更新、AI 失败时保留上次叙述。同日，sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker 发布了 v1.3.0，合并了 v1.2.0 和 v1.3.0 的工作。该版本引入了 scripts/discover-agents.mjs 用于只读代理发现和链安全检查、scripts/snapshot-summary.mjs 用于生成紧凑的模型快照摘要，并在推荐表格中新增了角色概览列。

releaseNotes.summary: 合并了 v1.2.0 和 v1.3.0 的工作。引入了 scripts/discover-agents.mjs 用于只读代理发现和链安全检查，以及 scripts/snapshot-summary.mjs 用于生成紧凑的模型快照摘要。在推荐表格中新增了角色概览列。
